findings.description: [00 t=4.250s] Settled Act 1 (ProtoType main): Strong protagonist dominance, crisp thin blue accent border, balanced 3-corner subs (yellow rhythm TL, blue/white graphic BL, two-character sketch TR), and neat 2x2 dock alignment. Minor: dock TL thumbnail is almost pure black (barely visible rim) and dock TR dark UI is very dim; faint WebP blocking on dark radial background.

[01 t=5.500s] Mid-transition Act 1->2: Protagonist hand-off reads causally (yellow rhythm has taken front z-order and blue accent border moving toward center while ProtoType recedes right without border), but the dock plate is 3/4 empty (only BL pointing-girl visible) because shuffling/arriving thumbnails vanished behind the plate. The blue card floats shrunk in lower-center-right dead space, and lossy WebP ghosting is visible inside the empty dock plate.

[02 t=6.000s] Settled Act 2 (yellow rhythm main, '81 Combo'): Clean hierarchy, crisp blue accent border, well-balanced subs (FoldLayers TL, dark UI BL, ProtoType TR), and neat 4/4 2x2 dock. Minor: TL FoldLayers sub is very dark and will lose legibility at ~350px wide.

[03 t=6.500s] Settled Act 2 (0.5s later, '83 Combo'): Smooth animation progression across protagonist and thumbnails (no frozen or stretched frames); hierarchy, border tracking, and 2x2 dock neatness remain solid.

[04 t=10.000s] Early transition Act 2->3: Yellow rhythm retains front z-order and blue border while AE timeline ('Just your timeline.') expands behind from TL. Only 2/4 dock slots are visible (TL blue, BR sketch), and a narrow transit sliver of the pointing-girl card peeks out between the protagonist's right edge and the dock plate's left edge.

[05 t=10.750s] Late transition Act 2->3: AE timeline cleanly assumes center, z-order, and blue border while corner subs transit coherently. Major dock regression: 3 of 4 dock slots are completely empty, leaving a single pale grey card isolated near the bottom-left of the dark dock plate — reads as cards wrongly disappearing/blinking rather than intentional depth.

[06 t=11.250s] Settled Act 3 (AE timeline 'But now'): Strong hierarchy, readable protagonist even at 350px, crisp blue border, balanced corner subs (pointing girl TL, teal BL, yellow TR), and neat 4/4 2x2 dock. Minor: dock TR dark UI thumbnail remains very dark/low-contrast.

[07 t=15.750s] Mid-transition Act 3->4: AE timeline ('Stop scrolling. Start creating.') holds z-order and blue border while pointing girl grows behind from TL. Major dock clipping defect: the receding yellow rhythm card is sharply sliced/guillotined across its bottom half by the top edge of the dock plate, protruding above the plate's top-left corner while the dock's bottom row is empty.

[08 t=16.250s] Late transition Act 3->4: Pointing girl cleanly takes center, z-order, and blue border with strong contrast; AE fades dark at TR and blue graphic seats at BL. Issues: TL sub sits on a flat mid-grey frame, and the dock's entire bottom row (2/4 slots) is empty while cards travel behind the plate.

[09 t=21.250s] Late Act 4 / Act 4->5 onset: Pointing girl ('祈りの') dominates cleanly with blue border, FoldLayers at TR, and blue graphic at BL. Major defects: (1) TL sub corner is completely black/missing, leaving an asymmetric hole; (2) a bright teal sliver ('かい...') protrudes sharply from behind the left edge of the dock plate while the dock's BR slot is empty.

[10 t=21.750s] Mid-transition Act 4->5: Pointing girl retains z-order/blue border shifting upper-right while blue/white grid card rises from BL. Excessive dead space across the entire upper-left quadrant (compounded by the vanished TL sub in frame 09); a clipped teal sliver peeks below the protagonist's bottom edge; FoldLayers floats above the dock while only 2/4 dock slots are populated.

[11 t=22.250s] Nearly settled Act 5 (blue/white grid '夜 / aaaa / Params'): Bold, high-contrast protagonist with crisp blue border that reads excellently at 350px; subs arriving (very dark ProtoType TL, teal BL, pointing girl TR). Major dock defect: even at t=22.25s after the protagonist has settled, 2/4 dock slots (TL, BR) remain empty and a thin ~2-3px grey transit sliver pokes out right above the top-left rounded edge of the dock plate.

verdict.summary: Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES. Settled acts (00, 02, 03, 06) and protagonist hand-offs are strong: visual hierarchy, protagonist dominance, ~62% blue accent border transfer, aspect ratios, animation continuity (no frozen/stretched frames), and ~350px README readability of the protagonists all work well. However, revision 6's behind-the-dock-plate occlusion rule (~12px threshold) fails aesthetically during transitions: (1) 2 to 3 of the 4 dock slots repeatedly vanish into an empty dark slab mid-transition (01, 05, 08, 10, 11), reading as glitchy pop-out/pop-in rather than intentional depth; (2) enlarging the dock plate did not eliminate transit slivers — cards still get harshly clipped by the dock's top/left perimeter (04, 07 yellow half-sliced, 09 teal sliver, 11 top-edge sliver); (3) Act 4->5 suffers a completely black/missing TL sub (09) and a large empty upper-left void (10); and (4) very dark clips (FoldLayers intro, DarkUI editor, ProtoType dark corners) sink into near-black holes in ~60px dock slots (~26px at 350px display width), alongside faint WebP dark-area ghosting in empty dock regions. Top 3 fixes by impact: (1) Keep dock-to-dock slot shuffles composited above the dock plate with deterministic z-order so the dock never flashes 3/4 empty, and replace hard behind-plate edge clipping on entering/leaving cards with smooth opacity/scale fade-in/out or clean above-plate curves staggered to avoid overlap; (2) Fix the missing/black TL sub in Act 4 (09), tighten Act 4->5 dock arrival timing so all 4 thumbs seat by t=22.25s without top-edge slivers (11), and balance upper-left dead space in 10; (3) Trim/offset pure-black frames on dark clips and add a slightly brighter inner rim on dock thumbnails so all 4 parked tiles stay legible at 350px wide.
